checks.name: Historical data quality and provenance
checks.evidence: Binance CEX dataset PASS: 8760 hourly bars for 2025, no quality errors, SHA-256 recorded. Required Solana DEX dataset unavailable: GeckoTerminal HTTP 401.

checks.name: Backtesting accounting correctness
checks.evidence: Shared fill/arithmetic checks, small terminal liquidation and sequential OOS capital reconcile equity/trade PnL. Historical conversion now preserves OHLCV/timestamps; direct and historical runners agree on volume-dependent fills.

checks.name: No look-ahead leakage
checks.evidence: Completed-candle signals execute at next open; delayed prefixes match replay. Continuous OOS preserves history and pending targets across parameter changes; gaps/invalid indices rejected. Risk checks use opening prices.

checks.name: Walk-forward validation
checks.evidence: Train-only selection and nine sequential OOS windows verified; corrected optimized CEX OOS -4.3722%, zero profitable windows and negative expectancy fail acceptance.

checks.name: Optimizer anti-overfitting
checks.evidence: Canonical report: inner split, minimum fit/validation trades, bounded grid, deterministic selection and distinct stability candidates verified. Auxiliary parameter selection ranks the training slice without nested validation; its capital path is now corrected.

checks.name: Parameter stability
checks.evidence: All nine training-neighborhood checks failed stability on the real CEX dataset.

checks.name: Stress testing
checks.evidence: All six configured scenarios executed through canonical fills/accounting; all nine OOS stress windows fail configured acceptance. Public historical acceptance uses actual per-window execution stress and measured training stability.

checks.name: Statistical robustness
checks.evidence: Seeded bootstrap and fixed-PnL permutations verified; mean-window 95% CI [-0.6343%, -0.3456%] fails positive-lower-bound acceptance. Malformed counts, rates, ranges and explicit failed verdicts fail closed.

checks.name: Stateful paper-trading correctness
checks.evidence: Incremental/full replay, delayed fills, immutable state/config and enforcing batch behavior passed. New realtime bars must be complete UTC hours with open timestamps at most two hours old; queued expiry is rejected.

checks.name: Risk enforcement and halt behavior
checks.evidence: Actual entry veto, closure after halt, no reversal/new exposure and storage latch verified. Valid operator requests immediately report halt; unstarted candles are rejected until durable HALT. An already submitted write may finish.

checks.name: Persistence, replay and idempotency
checks.evidence: Atomic single-owner journal, fsync, full record shape, sequence/conflict/replay and copy checks passed. V2 identity ignores object key order; legacy configuration hashes retain original ordering. restoreHalted returns only after durable HALT and handles uncertain writes; failure rejects recovery.

checks.name: Reproducible end-to-end research report
checks.evidence: Corrected real CEX report and frozen dataset retained. Repeated clean-tree research sections and exact CI summary/benchmark/gates match. Unchanged configuration/dataset/passive benchmark verified; failed acceptance returns exit 1; DEX HTTP 401 artifact retained.

checks.evidence: CI, Validation and Security passed on 31434ee. Downloaded Evidence artifacts confirm provider HTTP 401 and corrected failed strategy acceptance. Later commits require separate CI.
